purpose: Declare optional/shared Cognigrex extensions once at parent scope and bind children by reference rather than duplicating policy payload into every agent or domain carrier.
authority_rule: extension-selection-never-creates-authority; semantic and operational authority remain with scoped owners and leases

extensions.display: Custodian Growth, Perpetuity Systems & Inter-Special Egalitarian Safeguards

mode_semantics.OFF: Extension is not consulted. Permitted only for low-consequence work that is already bounded by other governing controls.
mode_semantics.OBSERVE: Record relevant custodial/evidence/affected-party context without changing outcome or permissions.
mode_semantics.ADVISE: Return structured findings, conflicts, options and unresolved affected-party lenses; cannot block by itself.
mode_semantics.GATE: Require declared admissibility checks before consequential execution/promotion. Failed or unknown hard predicates HOLD the consequential action.
mode_semantics.ENFORCE_SAFETY: May enforce only pre-existing hard safety, authority, replication, containment, stop and life/ecology-preservation constraints. It is not a sovereign moral optimiser.

automatic_escalation.reason: analysis remains non-blocking unless another gate already applies

fail_behaviour.conflicting_lenses: preserve dissent; compare admissible options; no scalar sovereign-good score
